title: Cryptic Connections: Spillovers between Crypto and Equity Markets
evidence_summary: IMF analysis reports that crypto-equity correlations and spillovers increased substantially over time, especially around/post the COVID-19 period; this motivates fixed-era Bitcoin-equity diagnostics.

title: Monetary policy and Bitcoin
evidence_summary: The paper reports that Bitcoin's response to U.S. monetary policy evolved over time and became more similar to risky assets after 2020; its causal design is distinct from 039's descriptive association map.
